subject.title: feat: heading-aware chunking + entity extraction for memory search

question: Should memory search adopt heading-aware markdown chunking now, and if so should it be the canonical default or an explicit strategy/config surface?
rationale: The source gap is real, but changing chunk boundaries affects persisted vector index identity and the issue also bundles broader entity extraction that belongs to a larger memory-wiki/MVP decision.

options.title: Scope Chunking First
options.body: Approve a focused heading-aware memory-search chunker with index-identity/rebuild handling, and keep entity extraction in a separate Memory MVP or memory-wiki thread.

options.title: Fold Into Memory MVP
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until the broader write pipeline and ingestion-helper issues define the permanent memory architecture.

options.title: Defer Core Change
options.body: Leave built-in memory chunking as token/overlap only and route users needing graph/entity extraction to other memory plugins or future plugin work.

recommendation.title: Scope Chunking First
recommendation.body: Approve a focused heading-aware memory-search chunker with index-identity/rebuild handling, and keep entity extraction in a separate Memory MVP or memory-wiki thread.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory-core index lifecycle and database work makes this the best available owner for the default/index-identity decision.
